summary: Then @anna_phd and @dogtrax get to pick the next @ncte poet. Serious I would throw together a quick 4-7 week pop up MOOC to revitalize the issue...we also turned from poetry after Haas became #walkmyworld bc we had so many other disciplines join. Get back to roots

body_html: Then @anna_phd and @dogtrax get to pick the next @ncte poet. Serious I would throw together a quick 4-7 week pop up MOOC to revitalize the issue...we also turned from poetry after Haas became #walkmyworld bc we had so many other disciplines join. Get back to roots
